evidence.claim: Deterministic first-round briefs (prompt-echo contamination double, no live model) have Jaccard similarity to the prior conclusion of 0.0 under memory-off and 0.0 under memory-on default (conclusion withheld). Explicit import_conclusion raises similarity to 0.5 (delta vs off=0.5). Default memory-on therefore does not import the prior CONCLUSION as a prior; the explicit import mode does, and records independence_assumption_void.
